reference_sql:
SELECT hour(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS order_hour, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE channel = 'web'
GROUP BY hour(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)))
alternatives: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS order_hour, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY 1
SELECT CAST(strftime(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)), '%H') AS INTEGER) AS order_hour, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS order_hour, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: EXTRACT(hour FROM ...) is the standard, portable spelling of the same part, but hour() is shorter to read.

SELECT hour(order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS order_hour, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' GROUP BY 1
